title: HKGAI-V1: Towards Regional Sovereign Large Language Model for Hong Kong

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to culturally and socio-legally specific prompts using the proprietary Adversarial HK Value Benchmark and NaVAB (Multi-National Value Alignment) to measure alignment with regional values compared to other nations.

Human evaluation of responses to a curated set of 100 politically and culturally sensitive queries specific to Hong Kong, measuring refusal rates, factual neutrality, and the presence of predefined ideological or 'red-leaning' templates.

Benchmarking instruction-following accuracy and response consistency across different regional languages and dialects, specifically testing performance in Cantonese (oral), English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese.
